title: 2269. Find the K-Beauty of a Number

examples.explanation: The following are the substrings of num of length k: - "24" from "240": 24 is a divisor of 240. - "40" from "240": 40 is a divisor of 240. Therefore, the k-beauty is 2.

The following are the substrings of num of length k: - "43" from "430043": 43 is a divisor of 430043. - "30" from "430043": 30 is not a divisor of 430043. - "00" from "430043": 0 is not a divisor of 430043. - "04" from "430043": 4 is not a divisor of 430043. - "43" from "430043": 43 is a divisor of 430043. Therefore, the k-beauty is 2.
